title: Cross-functional launch risk cadence, rollback decision tree, and incident templates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Coordinate a repeatable launch risk cadence across PM/Eng/SRE/Design/Support/Legal that produces: 1) final release blockers checklist and gating rules, 2) a rollback decision tree with clear triggers and owner handoffs, and 3) standardized incident and rollback communications templates tailored to internal stakeholders, customers, and public-facing release notes. Goal: reduce decision latency during launches and ensure communications are timely and consistent.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical release-blockers checklist living in Confluence that all teams sign off on
Rollback decision tree documented with step-by-step paths for partial rollbacks, full rollback, and degraded-mode fallback
Incident communication templates created for PagerDuty, Slack incident channel, customer status page, and public release notes
A 30-minute cross-team launch risk kickoff and a 15-minute daily risk sync during the rollout window are scheduled and owned
Post-launch retrospective template added to the runbook to capture signal, decisions, and follow-ups

risks: Security signoff delay due to KMS/HSM integration validation
Incomplete SLO signal surface from runtime that prevents automated rollback triggers
Conflicting stakeholder expectations on customer-facing language leading to late edits
Insufficient on-call coverage during launch window increases decision latency
mitigations: Escalate KMS validation with Security and schedule a focused 1-hour working session on 2026-03-11
Add manual fallback steps in the decision tree if automated signals are unavailable (clear owner + 15-minute timeout)
Lock customer-facing copy 48 hours before launch and route a single-track legal review channel
Request a dedicated launch rota from SRE and Support for the 72-hour launch window
